review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature mouth part (PROPOSED): a raptor's hooked beak, a deep keeled upper mandible arcing into a sharp hook over a shorter lower mandible, with a yellow cere and nostril slits; opens, hooks and lengthens on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartBeakHooked_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartBeakHooked_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the lower mandible dropped 26 degrees at the gape
the hook's outer half curled 22 degrees further under
the beak 30% longer past the cere

part_rules.handles_note: All three keys are on BeakHooked and BeakHookedLower with the same names; the runtime sets them together. H1_Open moves only the lower mandible, H2_Hook only the upper.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: side view reads as a raptor's beak - a deep keeled upper mandible arcing into a pointed hook that overhangs the shorter lower mandible, the two closed along a seam with the upper's edges flanking the lower; the cere stands proud as a clean ring band; handles render as named (H1_Open drops the lower mandible, H2_Hook curls the hook under, H3_Length draws it out).
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: two distinct finishes - slate-blue horn darkening to a near-black hook with fine lengthwise grain, and a saturated yellow waxy cere with one round dark nostril each side; the material borders are clean rings (the lower mandible is kept undecimated for that).
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the horn's soft highlight runs along the keel and the hook, nothing clips and the underside of the hook stays readable.
review_notes.gate4_godot: unverified: not yet seen in the creature editor (more_parts_shots.gd)

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
